== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ローグ1</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客を合計で2名乗せられる。ルークが操縦しているなら耐：損耗＜3。ホスの位置に対してのみリアクションとして移動できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">またの名をローグ・リーダー。ホスの戦いでスノースピーダー隊を率いた。密閉型。スカイウォーカー中佐が操縦し、ダク・ロルタが尾砲の砲手を務めた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Rogue 1.

'''Lore''' — Also known as Rogue Leader. Led the snowspeeder unit at the Battle of Hoth. Enclosed. Commander Skywalker piloted, with Dack Ralter as tail gunner.

'''Game text''' — May carry two pilots or passengers in total. Immune to attrition less than 3 if Luke is piloting. May move as a react only to a Hoth location.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore says またの名を (also known as) rather than “Designated”, and 中佐 rather than Commander. Game text uses 位置 rather than Hoth sites, and 乗せられる rather than “may add”.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-rogue1.gif|Original English face]], [[Rogue 1]].</ref>
